name: Gen 1&2 Soundtrack
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: 53 authentic FRLG, HGSS & GB Sounds tracks covering EVERY PokéBonk song including all seasonal events.
description: Complete Gen 1 & Gen 2 Pokémon soundtrack curated from FireRed/LeafGreen, HeartGold/SoulSilver, and GB Sounds (53 tracks total). Covers every single PokéBonk song including Main Menu, Halloween / Lavender Tower Night (Lavender Town FRLG), Johto Ecruteak Sunset (Bell Tower HGSS), Dynamax Sky (Sinjoh Ruins HGSS), Mewtwo Strikes Back Boss Rush (Battle! Mewtwo FRLG), all 5 In-Game battle themes, dungeons, and legendary/champion bosses. Pairs seamlessly with Classic Sound Effects via the Classic Gen 1&2 Audio Collection Modpack.
highlights: Covers EVERY PokéBonk song & seasonal event: Main Menu, Lavender Tower Night, Johto Sunset, Dynamax Sky, Mewtwo Boss Rush, all 5 In-Game slots, and Bosses
53 curated FireRed/LeafGreen, HeartGold/SoulSilver, and 8-bit GB Sounds tracks
Configurable default Title Screen / Main Menu theme right in Mod Configs
Client-side audio mod: safe to use in P2P Co-op even if teammates don't have it installed
